question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a white ball, Bob has a silver ball, Claire has a orange ball, Dave has a red ball, Eve has a black ball, Fred has a gold ball, and Gertrude has a green ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Dave and Fred swap balls. Then, Dave and Bob swap balls. Then, Alice and Fred swap balls. Then, Eve and Alice swap balls. Then, Claire and Fred swap balls. Then, Dave and Bob swap balls. Finally, Gertrude and Dave swap balls. At the end of the game, Claire has the
Options:
(A) white ball
(B) silver ball
(C) orange ball
(D) red ball
(E) black ball
(F) gold ball
(G) green ball
solution:
Ball colors in each row are ordered by holder: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: white, silver, orange, red, black, gold, green
1. Dave ↔ Fred: white, silver, orange, gold, black, red, green
2. Dave ↔ Bob: white, gold, orange, silver, black, red, green
3. Alice ↔ Fred: red, gold, orange, silver, black, white, green
4. Eve ↔ Alice: black, gold, orange, silver, red, white, green
5. Claire ↔ Fred: black, gold, white, silver, red, orange, green
6. Dave ↔ Bob: black, silver, white, gold, red, orange, green
7. Gertrude ↔ Dave: black, silver, white, green, red, orange, gold
Claire has the white ball, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
